async def act(page):
    # Click on the Reports link to expand the menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Reports', exact=True)
    await reports_link.click()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to expand
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Now click the Orders link under the Reports menu
    # Use filtering to ensure we select the correct menu path: menubar > menu > menu > menu > link 'Orders'
    orders_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('menu').filter(has=page.get_by_role('menu').filter(has=page.get_by_role('menu').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name='Orders', exact=True)))).get_by_role('link', name='Orders', exact=True)
    await orders_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
